cohort: Pregnant women with polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) who delivered at the study institution between January 1, 2018 and February 10, 2024.
finding: Low-dose aspirin (LDA) did not show statistically significant efficacy in preventing preeclampsia among high-risk pregnant women with PCOS, and maternal and neonatal outcomes were comparable between LDA and non-LDA groups.
